name: crossgen-r57-receipt-to-r56-counter
note: direction B for r58: the COMMITTED r57-shape receipt is refused by the r58 counter on schema. schema-wrong is emitted FIRST (order asserted), then nonce-shape; the nonce-derived swallow domain is recorded in couldNotEvaluate as nonce-unusable, never silently passed. The reverse direction (the r57 counter refuses the r58 receipt) runs at the L1's data pass on committed bytes.
